visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair and a black 'miu miu' cap stands in a brightly lit indoor space, holding a large brown cardboard box with the 'UGG' logo. She wears a brown ribbed top and beige trousers. The background is a minimalist white hallway with high ceilings. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a wooden floor with a white rug where the shoebox sits. A hand opens the box, peeling back white logo-printed tissue paper to reveal a pair of chunky brown and cream platform sneakers. (3) The woman holds one shoe (model Astromel) up to the camera, pointing at the thick beige sole and the unique brown-and-white patterned laces. She has a cheerful expression with focused eye contact. (4) A montage shows her sitting on the floor putting on the shoes, then standing for a full-body mirror selfie wearing beige wide-leg pants and a cap. Animated stars and hearts occasionally frame the shot. (5) She switches to a school-style outfit with a white vest, brown tie, and pleated skirt, wearing the shoes with white socks and beige leg warmers. (6) A second pair of beige 'oat milk' colored shoes (EZ-Duzzit) is introduced. She shows the 'biscuit' style sole and additional white laces. (7) Final sequence shows the woman posing in various outfits to demonstrate the versatility of both shoe styles, concluding with a shot of her legs in both pairs side-by-side.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: UGG秋冬新款開箱. [Logo]: UGG. (2) [Subtitle]: 這次收到兩雙 一起打開看看吧. (3) [Variety]: 好好看🥰❤️. (4) [Subtitle]: UGG不是只有雪靴 他們也有出這種休閒鞋款 而且都是厚底 完全就是我的菜. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們先來看這一雙 型號: Astromel. (6) [Subtitle]: 我覺得它的鞋帶超級可愛 它有這種編織的撞色感 然後這雙的底 起碼有個五六公分吧 超級厚 適合適合我這個小隻女. (7) [Subtitle]: 哇這雙的包覆感很強誒 因為它整個外層都蠻厚的 就可以把你的腳 整個包起來的感覺 超級可愛這雙. (8) [Subtitle]: 這雙很適合搭配落地寬褲 很帥性的感覺 重點是它夠增高我真超愛 落地褲都不會落地了. (9) [Subtitle]: 這雙如果你想要配短褲或短裙 會露腳的話 我覺得搭配泡泡襪會比較適合 因為它的鞋型有點大頭鞋 穿薄的襪子可能會顯得腳太細 比例不好看. (10) [Variety]: 搭泡泡襪呈學院風增加造型感🦷🦷. (11) [Subtitle]: 再來試第二雙鞋款 型號: EZ-Duzzit Essential Lace Up. (12) [Subtitle]: 這雙鞋款呢 我覺得比起上一雙它再休閒一點 然後它的鞋底前面是 餅乾鞋的設計 後面是拼這種白色的厚底 它這厚底公分數應該也有個五六公分 真的很像 然後它一樣有附一個 素色的鞋帶 是可以替換的 它是比較燕麥奶茶的顏色 基本上也是很百搭. (13) [Subtitle]: 很溫柔的燕麥奶茶色 上面有一些縫線設計的小巧思. (14) [Variety]: 更休閒輕巧. (15) [Subtitle]: 這雙就更休閒輕巧 搭配長褲短褲短裙都蠻適合 而且這雙腳感很輕喔 底也很軟. (16) [Subtitle]: 兩雙UGG秋冬鞋款開箱 你們比較喜歡哪一雙呢 趕快留言跟我分享吧.
